caption: Strength training for busy women means training to carry, not to shrink. Stairs, bags, car seats: life asks for strength. Five patterns, ten minutes a day.

voiceover.text: Every ad tells you to take up less space.
Meanwhile your life keeps asking for more strength.
The stairs with a sleeping child. The airport bag.
The groceries, the car seat, the fourth floor.
Nobody carries that by being smaller.
So stop training to shrink. Train to carry.
Push something. Pull something. Squat, hinge, brace.
Five patterns. That is the whole secret.
Ten minutes a day builds a body that lifts.
Strong is not a look. It is a capacity.
Your shoulders carry your actual week.
Your strength goes everywhere you do.
Tomorrow your doorframe becomes a back machine.
What did you carry this week?

overlays.text: You were told to take up less space.
Life keeps asking you to carry more.
Train to carry, not to shrink.
Ten minutes a day. Five patterns.
Strong is a capacity, not a look.
What did you carry this week?
